title: SIU investigating fatal police-involved shooting in Tecumseh
article: A provincial investigation is underway after Tecumseh area Ontario Provincial Police responded to a call regarding a "man in distress" late Friday that resulted in the injury of three officers and the death of a 48-year-old man.

According to a release from the province\'s Special Investigations Unit over the weekend, area OPP officers responded around 10:15 p.m. Friday in the 600 block of Estate Park in Tecumseh, near Pike Creek, east of the Saint Clair Beach shopping area.
The SIU release says there was an altercation between the man and officers inside the house. Three officers were injured. One police officer discharged his firearm, striking the civilian.
The man was transported to the hospital where he was pronounced dead. The three officers were also taken to the hospital for treatment. They have since been released.

The SIU is investigating the circumstances. Three investigators and two forensic investigators have been assigned to the case, while five witness officers and one subject officer have been designated.
The SIU is an arms-length organization that investigates reports involving police where there has been death, serious injuries or sexual assault allegations.
A post-mortem surrounding the incident was scheduled for Sunday in London.
No further details have since been released.
Anyone with information about this incident is urged to contact the SIU at 1-800-787-8529. Refer to case number 19-PFD-134.
Anyone with video evidence is invited to upload it to the SIU website (www.siu.on.ca).
